responsibility: Defines the FR-V operand and operator predicates used by the machine description and generated recognizer code. These predicates classify legal registers, immediates, addresses, memory forms, condition-code operands, accumulator/media operands, relational operators, and conditional-execution-capable expressions, encapsulating FR-V-specific legality tests such as GPR/FPR/ACC classes, signed immediate widths, GOT12 handling, reload-sensitive memory acceptance, and special compare/minmax/operator forms used throughout frv.md.
